        public IEnumerable<(Mesh Mesh, int MeshIndex, string Name, long LoDMask)> GetEmbeddedMeshesAndLoD()
        {
            // vpkstuff patch: default to mask 1 (LoD 0 visible) when the masks array doesn't
            // cover this mesh. CS2 models with only embedded meshes (CTRL-block MVTX format)
            // ship an EMPTY m_refLODGroupMasks, so the upstream .Zip yields nothing and the
            // embedded meshes are silently lost.
            var masks = Data.GetIntegerArray("m_refLODGroupMasks");
            var i = 0;
            foreach (var m in GetEmbeddedMeshes())
            {
                var mask = i < masks.Length ? masks[i] : 1L;
                yield return (m.Mesh, m.MeshIndex, m.Name, mask);
                i++;
            }
        }
